hub.tagline: Clear the board by matching tiles that are equal or sum to 10, connected by a straight or single-bend path.

all.title: Equal numbers match
all.desc: Tap any two tiles. They match if they show the same number -- clear them and keep going.

all.title: Numbers summing to 10 also match
all.desc: 3 + 7 = 10 -- that pairing counts as a match too, just like two equal numbers.

all.title: A path can bend once
all.desc: Tiles don't need to share a row or column -- a connecting path with a single 90-degree turn through an empty cell still counts. Diagonal jumps and more than one bend don't.

all.title: Blocked paths don't count
all.desc: If the straight line -- or the single bend -- passes through a tile that still has a number on it, the path is blocked. Clear it first, or pick a different pair.

all.title: Stuck? Use Add Numbers. Clear everything to win.
all.desc: No path? Tap Add Numbers to bring every remaining tile down as a new row -- it's a limited resource (5 per level), so use it when you need it. Clear every tile on the board, including anything you've added, to win the level.

game.legend: tap two tiles that are equal or sum to 10 -- connect with a straight or single-bend path
game.hintFailToast: No matches available right now -- try Add Numbers.
game.addNumbersFailToast: No Add Numbers left for this level.
game.winSubtitle: Every tile cleared -- next board unlocked.
game.failSubtitle: You're out of Add Numbers and there's no legal move on the board.
